name: Sembly AI
tagline: AI meeting assistant that turns calls into client-ready deliverables.
description: Sembly AI is an AI meeting assistant that joins Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet and Webex as a virtual participant to record, transcribe and analyze conversations. Its Semblian agent generates summaries, action items and client-ready deliverables like proposals, briefs and minutes, and supports transcription in 40+ languages. Offers EU and US data residency with SOC 2 Type II compliance.

modelSupport.notes: Semblian agent generates summaries, tasks and client deliverables.

edge: Geared to professional-services teams: its Semblian agent drafts proposals and briefs, not just notes, with EU/US data residency and SOC 2.
pros: EU/US data residency, SOC 2 Type II
